description: Implementation of SCTP network server including association management, message handling, and notifier classes.

classes.name: sctp_network_server_impl
classes.description: Implements SCTP network server with association handling, message reception, and notification processing.

classes.name: sctp_associaton_context
classes.description: Holds context information for each SCTP association, including address and shutdown flag.

classes.name: sctp_send_notifier
classes.description: Handles sending data over SCTP associations and manages connection shutdown signaling.

methods.name: create_and_bind
methods.description: Creates and binds the SCTP socket to specified addresses.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives messages from SCTP socket, handling data and notifications.

methods.name: handle_socket_shutdown
methods.description: Handles cleanup and shutdown of SCTP socket and associations.

methods.name: handle_data
methods.description: Processes incoming data for a specific association.

methods.name: init_association_with_msg
methods.description: Initializes a new SCTP association with a destination address and payload.

methods.name: handle_notification
methods.description: Processes SCTP notifications such as association change and shutdown events.

methods.name: handle_association_shutdown
methods.description: Handles shutdown of a specific SCTP association.

methods.name: handle_sctp_shutdown_comp
methods.description: Completes shutdown of an SCTP association and removes it.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming SCTP associations.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: subscribe_to_broker
methods.description: Subscribes socket to IO broker for event handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize SCTP server instance.
